Create one original polished imaginative narrative illustration, landscape 3:2. Title concept (DO NOT write any text): 'The Orange Wakes Before the City'. A freshly hand-peeled mandarin orange on a worn pale kitchen table has become a tiny lively morning bread market. The orange occupies most of the frame, placed slightly right of centre. Its peel is still physically connected at the base: one broad irregular strip curls up and over to form a convincing intimate canopy, with thick spongy ivory pith on its underside and extremely tactile orange oil pores outside. Under this peel canopy, a miniature ordinary woman baker in an indigo apron leans forward to hand a small paper bag of bread to an older customer in a moss-green jacket; their clear gentle gesture is the heart of the image. A modest wooden counter, three distinct bread shapes, crumpled paper bag, small linen towel and flour dust. A second loose peel flap curls toward the left foreground and makes a little curved sunlit walkway where a woman in a rust-red coat pushes a simple bicycle with a shopping basket; visible complete wheels, plausible hand positions. A few moist translucent mandarin segments rise behind the stall, luminous and fragrant-looking, but no anthropomorphic fruit. In the lower right foreground a tiny terracotta pot of white daisies and an empty low stool. The kitchen context is subtle: a real life-size teaspoon partly cropped along far left edge and softly unfocused linen behind, no additional dominant objects. Early morning side sunlight from upper left, delicate long contact shadows, lively fresh warmth rather than sepia. Palette saturated natural orange, milk white, indigo apron, muted leaf green. Blend lovingly hand-drawn ink-and-gouache miniature human figures with astonishingly tactile fruit and wood, coherent perspective and shadows; editorial picture-book craft, not generic plastic 3D. View at table level slightly above the stall so fruit structure and small social event are both readable; asymmetrical, intimate, not a centered product advertisement. Shallow but restrained depth of field: main people, stall and peel clearly legible. Scene must feel lived-in, warm, surprising and specific. No text, no lettering, no watermark, no border, no logo. No glass dome, no floating objects, no nonsensical extra doors, no decorative glowing particles. All people are fictional adults. Do not imitate a named artist or copy any existing illustration.
